items.statement: Management expects to be self-sufficient in funding CAPEX from internal accruals without hampering cash flows, maintaining a mix of debt and equity.
items.quote: Self sufficient in doing the CAPEX, but does not hamper the cash flows, we always keep a mix and match of debt and equity because if you see my credit, facilities that T have, I am not using it 100%, that reflects in the credit rating that has been given by CRISIL as well.

items.statement: Management indicates current debt levels around Rs. 400 crore may remain near the same level over the next two years, with only a small potential increase.
items.quote: And going forward if you see after two years the current debt would also be repaid. So it should be near to the same level of 10% highes than what we are today.

items.statement: Management states no equity dilution planned; growth will be funded through internal accruals and existing credit facilities.
items.quote: Not necessarily if the company is having enough CAPEX or cash flows for the CAPEX, we might not take any debt or a small debt maybe.

items.statement: Management states seed production is exempt from income tax, resulting in low tax payments and good cash flows.
items.quote: Seed industry do not have income tax as seed production is exempted from income tax. And you can see major players in the industry are also doing the same.

items.statement: Management confirms a buyback from the open market occurred in the last 15 days.
items.quote: Sir, I have buyback from open market in last 15 days only, but yes, we will take your note.

items.statement: Inventory and receivables aging improved except for KTM-related stock buildup
items.quote: Yeah, other than KTM everything is improving. As Prabh has already explained you know, since they are on active recovery mode, so first step will be to liquidate the inventory.

items.statement: Oil business is a cash market with maximum 10 days payment; spices in South India is a 2-3 month credit market
items.quote: Oil is a completely 10 maximum is the 10 days payment. So we don't require more capital for the capex for the oil and we already as I said funds has been sufficient for us for next two years also, next financial year so we don't need further funds actually.

items.statement: Poushtik e-commerce is 100% cash business with no credit; only initial capex needed
items.quote: As you know, if there is no credit in this segment, e-commerce. That is a completely 100% cash. So we don't need much. Only for the start we need a capex. Later on we don't need the capex.

items.statement: Promoters did not participate in the recent rights issue due to lack of capital
items.quote: For the right issue thing, Mr. Rajeev, we have already informed in the letter of offer that promoters are not going to participate in the right issue. So it is their interest and I mean it is because of lack of few capital involved so they could not participate.

items.statement: Groundnut oil plant investment is approximately INR15 crores including working capital
items.quote: So almost, it will be INR15 crores almost, including this working capital.

items.statement: Poushtik marketing budget is INR25 lakhs for first quarter; thereafter profits will fund advertising
items.quote: We have planned the advertisement budget of first quarter of the launches, only INR25 lakhs we are going to launch. So I know it's very less budget to do the marketing, but we are going to do the smart marketing.

items.statement: Company has sufficient funds from October rights issue for next two years; no further fundraising needed
items.quote: We already raised the rights in the October. So we can utilize that fund for our oil also from parallelly. Only the spices segment is quite tricky in actually South India is a huge credit market in completely South India is the same with the spices, not with the other. items.statement: Merger approved with share exchange ratio of 100 Kopran Limited shares for 45 Kopran Laboratories shares
items.quote: The proposed share exchange ratio is 100 fully paid up equity shares of Kopran Limited against 45 fully paid up equity shares of Kopran Laboratories Limited after receiving all the regulatory approvals.
